[hl]Ryo[hl]: Ah!? Wh-what is this?[wait][page][hl]X Special uses +1!![hl][ENDK]
[hl]Ryo[hl]: .........Curse that Echigoya! Such a cowardly trick......[wait][page][hl]LIFE restored![hl][ENDK]
We are... the Armored Demon Ninja Squad![wait][page]Ninja of the Gray Clan![ENDK]
[wait][page]You will go no further, even if it costs us our lives![ENDK]
[hl]Armored Demon Ninja Squad[hl]: Glory to us![wait][END]
[hl]Gray Clan Ninja[hl]: I have... fail...ed... Ngh......[ENDK]
[hl]Green Clan Ninja[hl]: That we... would be... de...feated... ......Curses... Gurgh...[ENDK]
[hl]Ryo[hl]: Midori!! Where are you? Where?[wait][page][hl]Kappa Samurai[hl]: !?[wait][page]Intruder!! An intruder is attacking![ENDK]

[wait][page][hl]Kokin Hyakuseki[hl]: Now, now...... no need to panic.[wait][page]"Amid the battle / the samurai of the west / might it be myself?"[wait][page]Mm... You see, I simply adore composing waka poetry......[wait][page]Anyone who disturbs it cannot be allowed to live. Please don't take it personally.[ENDK]
[hl]Kokin Hyakuseki[hl]: "In defeat, alas / he who knows not where he goes / is the victor, hm"... Gwah.[ENDK]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: Hey! You there, killer! Where is Midori!?[wait][page][hl]Armored Samurai SUKE[hl]: What was that!![wait][page]I've never cut down anyone in my life! Don't insult me![wait][page][hl]Armored Samurai KAKU[hl]: Who cares! Let's just cut this guy down![wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: What!? Bring it on![ENDK]
[hl]Armored Samurai SUKE[hl]: Beaten... by a... mere... ninja......[ENDK]
[hl]Armored Samurai KAKU[hl]: N-no way... We... got... beat...[ENDK]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: Midori...... I was worried! Are you hurt?[wait][page][hl]Midori[hl]: Ryo... thank you. I knew you would come for me.[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: Midori......[wait][page]Our joyful reunion must wait until later![wait][page]If Echigoya's men find you, you will be captured again.[wait][page]For now, please go home and wait for me![wait][page]I must deal with Echigoya...... Now hurry! We will meet up later!![wait][END]
[hl]Ryo[hl]: Ah!? What is this!?[wait] Nothing at all, it seems.[wait][END]

[hl]Echigoya[hl]: A pity... A real pity.[wait][page]You refused to listen to me...... and then you go and do this...[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: .........[wait][page]It seems you still do not know who you are dealing with![wait][page][hl]Echigoya[hl]: Ha ha ha![wait][page]Oh, I know perfectly well. A complete fool, am I right? Ha ha ha![wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: What did you say!?[wait][page]Ah, wait!![wait][END]
[hl]Echigoya[hl]: Now then...[wait][page]What happens to those who defy me...[wait][page]I'll teach you a thorough lesson... Ha ha ha![wait][END]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: .........Where am I? What is this place!?[wait][page][hl]Mysterious Old Man[hl]: Ryo, my boy...[wait][page]Sorry to drag you off to a place like this so suddenly.[wait][page]This is... the year NEA 1403.[wait] In other words... some 700 years before your own time.[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: What are you talking about? Who are you?[wait][page][hl]Mysterious Old Man[hl]: My name is... [hl]Forfahren[hl].[wait][END]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: ......!?[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Tell me, do you know of wizards?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: Wizards......?[wait][page]You mean those things from the foreign priests' tales?[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Hmm, well... something like that.[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: Hmm, it seems you are no villain.[wait] So...... you are one of these wizards?[wait][page]But what business would you have with a ninja like me?[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Ho ho ho, no need to be so formal.[wait][page]Besides, I'm not going to eat you.[wait][page]Though if you insist, you're welcome to test my magic...[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: What!?[wait][page]My ninja arts could never lose to some foreign sorcery![wait][END]

[hl]Forfahren[hl]: Ho ho ho...[wait][page]But attack is not all there is to magic![wait][page]Using that magic, I watched your battle with Echigoya from here.[wait][page]And so...... I have a favor to ask. What do you say?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: .........[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: The favor is this...[wait][page]I want you to help me stop the revival of the [hl]Penta Dragon[hl]![wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: The Penta Dragon?![wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: That's right.........[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: .........[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: That Echigoya from before......[wait][page]What if the Penta Dragon was lurking in his shadow?[wait][END]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: What!? Echigoya?[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Indeed...... You can't let that stand, can you?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: That... is certainly true, but......[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Splendid! You've made up your mind![wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: Wait! Just one last time...[wait][page]Will you let me return to Neo Edo?[wait][page]Once that is done......[wait] Very well.[wait][page]Until the day the Penta Dragon falls, my life is in your hands![wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Very well! Off you go![wait][page]And when you're ready, call my name... Until then......[wait][END]

[hl]Midori[hl]: Huh?! Ryo......? What did you just say?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: That I may never see you again.[wait][page][hl]Midori[hl]: No![wait][page]Then...... why? Why did you save me?![wait][page]If I can't see you anymore, I'd rather Echigoya had killed me!![wait][END]
[hl]Ryo[hl]: .........It is for your sake. Please forgive me...[wait][page]I must go, no matter what. I am truly sorry......[wait][END]
Forfahren! Can you hear me?[wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: Yes, I hear you. But...... are you sure about this?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: .........[wait][END]

[hl]Forfahren[hl]: Are you truly all right with leaving her like that?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: I am a ninja![wait][page]I live by the way of the shinobi. I have no need of a family![wait][page][hl]Forfahren[hl]: .........[wait] Well then, let us be off.[wait][END]

[hl]Ryo[hl]: .........Where am I?[wait][page][hl]Mysterious Old Man[hl]: Sorry to drag you off to a place like this so suddenly.[wait][page]Ryo, my boy...[wait] This is... the year NEA 1403.[wait][page]In other words... some 700 years before your own time.[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: Who are you!?[wait][page][hl]Mysterious Old Man[hl]: My name? Ho ho ho.........[wait][page]My name is... [hl]Graph[hl].[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: And what business have you with me?[wait][END]

[hl]Graph[hl]: Well now...... I have two wishes.[wait][page]The first... is to stop the revival of the Penta Dragon.[wait][page]The second... is to stop the misdeeds of an evil wizard, who is also my friend![wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: .........[wait][page]And what does that have to do with me?[wait][page][hl]Graph[hl]: I'm glad you asked! But there's only one answer.[wait][page]The only one who can save this world is Ryo of the Heaven Clan...... you![wait][page]That's all there is to it. Won't you understand?[wait][page][hl]Ryo[hl]: ......[wait][page]I find that hard to believe. You are up to something, are you not?[wait][page][hl]Graph[hl]: Now, now, don't say that.[wait][page]So how about it...... Won't you lend me your strength, no questions asked?[wait][page]<What will you do?>[ENDK]
[hl]Graph[hl]: Oh, don't say that. Won't you do this for me?[wait][page]<What will you do?>[ENDK]
[hl]Graph[hl]: Oh, you will! I'm truly grateful!![wait][page]Now, first of all...[wait][page]Oops, that's right. Before we talk, there's this![wait][END]
